sources.what: Everything in Wikidata that has a flag (P41) and that at least 40 pages of Wikimedia sites tell of, by its Wikidata id: what the lists of scripts/data/flags-lists.json are made from. items: its names in Spanish and in English (es, en), how many pages tell of it (links), what it is (is: P31), the country it is in (in: P17), the years it began and ended (from, to: P571 and P576), and its flags, each with its file, its rank when it is not the usual one and the days it flew between; what the game already has says only as what (game: country, piece or city). classes: the English name of each class

sources.what: The flags that are signals, each a file of Commons that scripts/data/flags-signals.json names, by the id the list gives it. items: that file (file; by: hand, as every one is). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; where the file is kept in this branch (kept); the 960 px picture that Wikimedia draws of it (picture), which stands for an original of more than 2 MB and goes with a drawing that has words in it (words); for a photograph, the drawing of the same flag that is kept in its place (drawn); and the categories of Commons it is in that speak of other times, of a proposal or of an invention, which may mean that it is not a flag that flies (marks). The files themselves are under flags/files, each named after its SHA-1.
